description.zh: Prometheus实例ID。仅支持aliyun-cs和ecs两种类型的实例。
description.en: The ID of the Prometheus instance. Only aliyun-cs and ecs instances are supported.
The integration type. Valid values: kafka, mysql, redis, snmp, emr, nubela, and tidb.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms list-prometheus-integration --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --cluster-id c77f6f2397ea74672872acf5e31000000 --integration-type kafka --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
